notes.title: QoL Update 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44626676/30a4862c5b920aef0db930cff55ee99595fc179c.gif[/img]

Super small update.  There might be a bigger update coming.

What changed:
Added an undo button to the end game menu when you lose.
Beating a level now has sparkly particles.

notes.title: Improved Collision
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44626676/a39f5132bae3555d621e43db0604a1be5c8c037b.gif[/img]

Hey, small update for the penguins.

Collision has been improved.  Colliding would often confuse the poor penguins and they wouldn't notice fish that were right next to them!

You can now right click with your mouse to undo.  Much easier than hitting the button in the corner.  Now I have to figure out how to tell players who don't read patch notes...

notes.title: Bug Fix 2 - Map Loading Error
notes.content:
Big fix!

Some players couldn't play because of floating point localization! This should no longer be the case!  If you lived in Germany, Finland, or Canada, this may have helped!

notes.title: Bug fix 1
notes.content:
Some players have experienced inconsistency when penguins would slide past seals.  Sometimes the seals would not notice!

This should now be fixed.  Please report any instances of this still happening in the forums.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44626676/18a568b202dd4e33513cf5d9a1b20a3136fe23a7.gif[/img]

notes.title: QoL Update 1
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I hope you and the penguins are having fun!

This is the first of a few Quality of Life updates due to player feedback.  Thanks for letting me know how to make the game better.  Keep it coming!

This update adds the ability to rotate the map.  You can click the Eye icon in the upper left, or press spacebar.

When playing with creative mode, it no longer tricks you into deleting your map.

More to come.

Thanks!
LimeBlossom
